purpose: Verifiable provenance link between the original raw snapshot and the approved 253,264-row clean corpus. The referenced raw snapshot is preserved externally as defense/provenance material and is not shipped in this repository (upstream source licenses + parquet size). The clean corpus itself is also not shipped in this repository (data/ is gitignored); its SHA-256 is recorded here so any holder of the file can verify.

raw_snapshot.description: Original raw canonical.parquet used to produce the approved clean corpus.
raw_snapshot.preservation: external defense/provenance material (not in this repository)

clean_corpus.description: Approved clean.parquet — the frozen dataset that seeds every downstream split and the E8-P9 training corpus.
clean_corpus.preservation: external — data/ is gitignored; SHA-256 recorded here is the ground truth

lineage_verification.test: every sample_id present in clean.parquet must also be present in the referenced raw snapshot
lineage_verification.conclusion: The referenced raw snapshot is a valid preimage of the approved clean corpus.

repository_raw_note.status: later re-acquisition, NOT the original raw snapshot
repository_raw_note.difference_from_original: differs by 2 rows in the sms_spam_collection source; 546 clean sample_ids are absent from this later snapshot
repository_raw_note.purpose: kept for source-list traceability only; not a valid preimage of clean.parquet

reproducibility_note: The original acquisition/cleaning implementation is not shipped in this repository. Consequently, running the current repository will not reproduce the exact 253,264-row clean.parquet from the raw snapshot. What IS reproducible/verifiable from this repository is the downstream chain: given clean.parquet + the E8-chain scripts under scripts/data_prep/ + the merge_report.json files under data/synthetic_*/, the 283,501-row training corpus (data/interim/e7_p1_features_e8p9.parquet) is fully reconstructible. The raw → clean step relies on the externally preserved raw snapshot + the (external) acquire/clean implementation.
what_this_record_proves: The original raw snapshot exists and is preserved (not overwritten / lost).
The raw snapshot's identity is fixed by SHA-256, verifiable by anyone with the file.
The clean corpus is derivable from that raw snapshot (sample_id subset test passes exactly).
The in-repo canonical_raw.parquet is a documented later re-acquisition, not a substitute.
The per-source counts in the raw snapshot match the shipped acquisition_manifest.json exactly.
